column5: eVOLVE-Cervical, Phase 3 against placebo (800 planned) in FIGO 2018 stage IIIA to IVA cervical cancer that has not progressed after platinum chemoradiation, primary outcome PFS, primary completion 2027-11-26 (registry, last update 2026-11-10). A real second indication refused as a layer on three grounds. Pool: the study excludes 'Exposure to immune mediated therapy prior to the study for any indication' and 'Any prior (besides prior CCRT) or concurrent treatment for cervical cancer', and pembrolizumab is labelled 'in combination with chemoradiotherapy' for FIGO 2014 stage III-IVA disease (Keytruda label, DailyMed setid 9333c79b-d487-4538-a9f0-71b91a02b287, effective 2026-10-16), so the US pool is the stage III to IVA patients given chemoradiation without pembrolizumab, a share no free source measures. Uptake: Keytruda files one CMS Part B line across every indication (75,361 beneficiaries in 2024, drug_demand), so no capture of this setting by any checkpoint inhibitor can be read, and none other is labelled in it. Engine: an additions row on Uterine Cervical Neoplasms (D002583) would make this the asset's gate readout, because no NSCLC or mesothelioma Phase 3 readout is on its calendar, so it would carry the NSCLC value too and price a cervical miss at nil for the whole molecule

TRANSCEND, Phase 3 against placebo (132 enrolled) in kidney transplant recipients at least six months from transplant with biopsy-confirmed active or chronic active antibody-mediated rejection and HLA donor-specific antibody, primary outcome biopsy-proven histologic resolution at week 24, primary completion 2026-12-01 (registry, last update 2026-06-05). A real second indication refused as a layer on two grounds. Uptake: no therapy is approved for AMR ('no therapy has gained robust regulatory approval', Bohmig GA et al., Nephrol Dial Transplant 2025;40:1615-1627, PMID 40440205), so there is no launch to measure a capture from. Engine: MeSH has no AMR descriptor, and filing the study on Graft Rejection (D006084) would make TRANSCEND, which completes six months before PREVAIL (NCT06935357, 2027-05-31), the asset's gate readout: it would carry the IgAN value as well and price an AMR miss at nil for the whole molecule, though IgAN is a separate disease with its own Phase 3. Biogen values AMR as its own in-process R&D unit (FY2025 10-K 0000875045-26-000013, FelzartamabAMRMember), a shape this engine cannot give a pipeline asset

RENEW-ALC-1, Phase 3 against placebo (1,100 planned) in adults with moderate-to-severe alcohol use disorder who are seeking treatment, primary outcome change in drinking by timeline followback to week 56, primary completion 2028-04 (registry, last update 2026-10-07). A real second indication refused as a layer. The pool is citable: 27.1 million US adults had past-year AUD in 2024, of whom 7.5% (2.0 million) received alcohol use treatment and 2.4% (665,000) received medication (NSDUH 2024, Table 5.9A, as tabulated on NIAAA's alcohol use disorder and alcohol treatment statistics pages). Uptake is not: the only branded AUD launch, Vivitrol, files one net sales line across alcohol and opioid dependence ($467.9mm in 2025, Alkermes FY2025 10-K 0001193125-26-068925), and acamprosate, oral naltrexone and disulfiram are generic, so no launch's capture of the AUD pool can be measured. Overlap: on this pipeline asset the AUD pool's overlap with the treated MDD pool already valued (21,414,000 x 0.61) has to come out of eligible_pct, and this research found no free table splitting the AUD treatment pool by depression treatment. The gate is not the obstacle: the readout would be same_gate_later behind RENEW-MDD-1 (2028-02), a Phase 3 of the same stage

RENEW-ALC-2, Phase 3 against placebo (1,100 planned) in adults with alcohol use disorder of any severity who are seeking treatment, the twin of RENEW-ALC-1 (NCT07219966), primary outcome change in drinking by timeline followback to week 56, primary completion 2028-04 (registry, last update 2026-11-04). Refused as a layer on the grounds filed for RENEW-ALC-1: the pool is citable (27.1 million US adults with past-year AUD, NSDUH 2024) but no AUD launch's capture can be measured, since Vivitrol files one net sales line across alcohol and opioid dependence ($467.9mm in 2025, Alkermes FY2025 10-K 0001193125-26-068925) and the other AUD medicines are generic, and the overlap with the MDD pool already valued has no free split

OLYMPIA-4, Phase 3 (216 enrolled) of odronextamab against salvage chemoimmunotherapy then autologous transplant in aggressive B-cell lymphoma that is primary refractory or relapsed within 12 months of an anti-CD20 and anthracycline first line, with intent to transplant, primary outcome event-free survival, primary completion 2028-05-29 (registry, last update 2026-05-11). A real second-line indication refused as a layer. Pool: the DLBCL pool (19,046) is on file but no free source gives the share of diagnoses that are primary refractory or relapse within 12 months and are transplant-intended. The nearest, a Flatiron cohort of 10,016 first-line LBCL patients (Perales MA et al., Blood Adv 2026;10:5325-5337, PMID 42234934, PMC13449983), reports 30% starting any second line and a 205-patient second-line CAR T eligible cohort its authors call possibly undercaptured, neither a share of diagnoses. Uptake: the products labelled in this line, Yescarta and Breyanzi, file CMS Part B lines of 37 and 135 beneficiaries in 2024 (drug_demand), each across every line it is labelled in, so no second-line capture can be read; Perales gives 25.0% of clearly fit eligible patients receiving second-line CAR T, a share of the line and not a launch. The gate is not the obstacle: OLYMPIA-4 completes after OLYMPIA-1 (2028-02-29) and would be same_gate_later

Phase 2, 168 enrolled, JSB462 100 or 300 mg plus abiraterone against abiraterone or enzalutamide in high-volume metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer, primary outcome PSA90 rate, primary completion 2026-12-03 per the registry (last update 2026-11-13), not the 2032-02-13 nvs_jsb462.csv carries. A real second indication refused as a layer on three grounds. MeSH: there is no hormone-sensitive descriptor, and the parent, Prostatic Neoplasms (D011471), carries the post-ARPI mCRPC pool this asset is valued on, so filing the study there would let an mHSPC result decide the mCRPC value. Persistence: a pipeline asset carries one discontinuation for every indication, and this one's 51.18% a year comes from Pluvicto's post-ARPI rPFS of 11.60 months; ARPI-treated mHSPC progresses far more slowly (abiraterone plus ADT in LATITUDE, median rPFS 33.0 months, Fizazi K et al., N Engl J Med 2017;377:352-360, PMID 28578607, about 22% a year at a constant hazard), so an mHSPC layer would be charged less than half its time on drug. Gate: this is the asset's only readout on the calendar (the mCRPC Phase 2 NCT07047118, 2027-07-16, has no catalyst row), so a layer would make it the gate for the whole molecule
